package e2e

// 联盟服务阶段 5 的真实依赖端到端（FEATURE-2026-11-04-alliance-service §7 阶段 5）。由 scripts/test-alliance-e2e.sh
// 复制进新生成的 game-demo 的 e2e/ 目录后运行：生成工程的二进制起真实进程（alliance 两个实例、game 两个进程以及
// game 依赖的九个托管服务），测试进程只做调用方与观察者——经生成的路由 BusClient、玩家 TCP、运维 /admin 命令驱动，
// 不直接写任何内部格式（_remote_entity_meta、Redis 路由登记、WAL）。状态一律经正式入口造：建盟 / 入会走 RPC，
// 迁移走 alliance.transfer，崩溃用 kill -9，冻结用 SIGSTOP。
//
// 每个用例一个唯一前缀：NATS 主题 / 流、Mongo 库、Redis 键、etcd 键都带它，结束时删掉；进程的工作目录是用例自己的
// 临时目录（WAL、日志），configs 链接回生成工程。端口从 ALLIANCE_E2E_PORT_BASE 起按进程分配。

	"regexp"
	"slices"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"syscall"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
	"github.com/nats-io/nats.go/jetstream"
	goredis "github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"
	"github.com/spf13/viper"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/app"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	coreremote "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/remoteentity"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/network/bus"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/network/servicerpc"
	fmongo "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/storage/mongo"
	mongodriver "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/storage/mongo/driver"
	fredis "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/storage/redis"
	redisdriver "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/storage/redis/driver"

	rpcalliance "example.com/planet/internal/rpc/alliance"
)

// suite 是一个用例的现场：依赖地址、唯一前缀、起的进程与测试进程里的调用方。
type suite struct {
	t                                    *testing.T
	ctx                                  context.Context
	binary, accountctl, root, work, logs string
	mongoURI, natsURL, redisAddr         string
	proxiedRedis, toxiproxy, etcd        string
	prefix                               string
	portBase                             int

	mu    sync.Mutex
	procs map[string]*proc
	next  int

	bus     bus.IBus
	stopBus func()
	redis   *goredis.Client
	mongo   *mongo.Client
	owners  *countingOwners
	lookup  *coreremote.RouteLookup
	routes  *coreremote.RouteStore
}

// proc 是一个起过的服务进程。同名进程重启沿用端口与配置。
type proc struct {
	name, service string
	sid           int32
	config, log   string
	ops, client   string
	cmd           *exec.Cmd
	done          chan struct{}
	exitErr       error
}

func env(t *testing.T, name string) string {
	t.Helper()
	value := os.Getenv(name)
	if value == "" {
		t.Skipf("%s not set: run scripts/test-alliance-e2e.sh", name)
	}
	return value
}

// newSuite 读依赖地址、建唯一前缀与调用方客户端；用例结束时停全部进程、删本前缀的数据。
func newSuite(t *testing.T, timeout time.Duration) *suite {
	binary := env(t, "ALLIANCE_E2E_BINARY")
	s := &suite{
		t: t, binary: binary, accountctl: os.Getenv("ALLIANCE_E2E_ACCOUNTCTL"),
		root: env(t, "ALLIANCE_E2E_ROOT"), etcd: env(t, "ALLIANCE_E2E_ETCD"),
		mongoURI: env(t, "ROOST_DATAENGINE_IT_MONGO_URI"), natsURL: env(t, "ROOST_DATAENGINE_IT_NATS_URL"),
		redisAddr: env(t, "ROOST_DATAENGINE_IT_REDIS_ADDR"), proxiedRedis: os.Getenv("ROOST_DATAENGINE_IT_REDIS_PROXIED_ADDR"),
		toxiproxy: os.Getenv("ROOST_DATAENGINE_IT_TOXIPROXY_URL"),
		procs:     map[string]*proc{},
		prefix:    "a5" + strconv.FormatInt(time.Now().UnixNano()%1_000_000_000_000, 36),
	}
	s.portBase = 35100
	if raw := os.Getenv("ALLIANCE_E2E_PORT_BASE"); raw != "" {
		s.portBase, _ = strconv.Atoi(raw)
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), timeout)
	s.ctx = ctx
	s.work = t.TempDir()
	if err := os.Symlink(filepath.Join(s.root, "configs"), filepath.Join(s.work, "configs")); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	s.logs = filepath.Join(s.work, "logs")
	if dir := os.Getenv("ALLIANCE_E2E_LOGS"); dir != "" {
		s.logs = filepath.Join(dir, t.Name())
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(s.logs, 0o755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := registry.RegisterAll(); err != nil && !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "already") {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	s.connect()
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		s.stopAll()
		s.cleanup()
		cancel()
	})
	t.Logf("prefix %s, logs %s", s.prefix, s.logs)
	return s
}

// countingOwners 数路由查找回退到 Mongo 所有权记录的次数（方案 §5“Redis 不可用时的退化”要量的点读放大）。
type countingOwners struct {
	reader coreremote.OwnershipReader
	reads  atomic.Int64
}

func (c *countingOwners) GetRemoteOwnership(ctx context.Context, id int64) (entity.RemoteEntityMarkerLease, bool, error) {
	c.reads.Add(1)
	return c.reader.GetRemoteOwnership(ctx, id)
}

func (s *suite) connect() {
	t := s.t
	cfg := viper.New()
	cfg.Set("nats.url", s.natsURL)
	cfg.Set("nats.prefix", s.prefix)
	cfg.Set("server_type", "e2eclient")
	cfg.Set("sid", 9100)
	reg := app.NewRegistry(cfg)
	natsMod := kitnats.NewNatsMod(bus.MessagePackCodec{})
	for _, step := range []func() error{func() error { return natsMod.Init(cfg) }, func() error { return natsMod.Provide(reg) }, natsMod.Start} {
		if err := step(); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	s.stopBus = func() { natsMod.Stop() }
	s.bus, _ = app.Lookup[bus.IBus](reg, mods.ModBus)

	s.redis = goredis.NewClient(&goredis.Options{Addr: s.redisAddr})
	client, err := mongo.Connect(options.Client().ApplyURI(s.mongoURI))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	s.mongo = client
	s.routes, s.lookup, s.owners = s.newLookup(s.redisAddr)
}

// newLookup 建一份调用方路由查找（Redis 登记 → Mongo 所有权记录），与 game 进程经 RouteSource 用的是同一组件；
// 返回的 countingOwners 数它回退读所有权记录的次数。
func (s *suite) newLookup(redisAddr string) (*coreremote.RouteStore, *coreremote.RouteLookup, *countingOwners) {
	t := s.t
	redis, err := redisdriver.NewClient(&fredis.Config{Addr: redisAddr, PoolSize: 8, MinIdleConns: 1, DialTimeout: time.Second, ReadTimeout: time.Second, WriteTimeout: time.Second, MaxRetries: 0})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	mongoClient, err := mongodriver.NewClient(&fmongo.Config{URI: s.mongoURI, ConnectTimeout: 5 * time.Second, MaxPoolSize: 16, MinPoolSize: 1, MaxIdleTime: time.Minute, TransactionTimeout: 10 * time.Second}, mongodriver.IndexMigrationPolicy{})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	routes, err := coreremote.NewRouteStore(redis, s.prefix, 0)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	reader, err := coreremote.NewMongoOwnershipReader(mongoClient, s.prefix+"_remote")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	owners := &countingOwners{reader: reader}
	lookup, err := coreremote.NewRouteLookup(routes, owners)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return routes, lookup, owners
}

type lookupResolver struct{ lookup *coreremote.RouteLookup }

func (r lookupResolver) LookupRoute(ctx context.Context, id int64) (int32, error) {
	owner, found, err := r.lookup.LookupOwner(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if !found {
		return 0, servicerpc.EntityNotFound(id)
	}
	return owner, nil
}

type fixedOwner int32

func (o fixedOwner) LookupRoute(context.Context, int64) (int32, error) { return int32(o), nil }

// client 是生成的路由 BusClient；同一个客户端带路由缓存，新建一个就是空缓存。
func (s *suite) client(resolver servicerpc.RouteResolver, timeout time.Duration) *rpcalliance.BusClient {
	if resolver == nil {
		resolver = lookupResolver{s.lookup}
	}
	client, err := rpcalliance.NewBusClient(s.bus, resolver, "", timeout)
	if err != nil {
		s.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return client
}

// ---- 配置与进程 ----

var (
	opsAddr       = regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)^(\s+addr: )127\.0\.0\.1:91\d\d$`)
	advertiseAddr = regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)^(\s+advertise_addr: )127\.0\.0\.1:90\d\d$`)
	projectName   = regexp.MustCompile(`\bplanet(_[a-z]+)?\b`)
	l2Prefix      = regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)^(\s+snapshot_l2_key_prefix: )[^\n]*$`)
)

// setKey 改 section 下第一处 key 的值（缩进的子键也算）；找不到就失败，免得改了个寂寞。
func setKey(t *testing.T, text, section, key, value string) string {
	t.Helper()
	if strings.Contains(section, ".") {
		return setNestedKey(t, text, section, key, value)
	}
	pattern := regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)(^` + regexp.QuoteMeta(section) + `:\n(?:[ \t].*\n|\n)*?[ \t]+` + regexp.QuoteMeta(key) + `:)[^\n]*`)
	if !pattern.MatchString(text) {
		// 生成配置里没写的键（取缺省）：加在 section 的第一行。
		head := regexp.MustCompile(`(?m)^` + regexp.QuoteMeta(section) + `:\n`)
		if !head.MatchString(text) {
			t.Fatalf("config has no section %s", section)
		}
		return head.ReplaceAllString(text, section+":\n  "+key+": "+value+"\n")
	}
	done := false
	return pattern.ReplaceAllStringFunc(text, func(match string) string {
		if done {
			return match
		}
		done = true
		sub := pattern.FindStringSubmatch(match)
		return sub[1] + " " + value
	})
}

// 嵌套配置必须逐层定位，不能把 effect_consumer.workers 误改成 projection.workers。
func setNestedKey(t *testing.T, text, section, key, value string) string {
	t.Helper()
	lines := strings.Split(text, "\n")
	begin, end, indent := 0, len(lines), 0
	for depth, part := range strings.Split(section, ".") {
		found := -1
		for i := begin; i < end; i++ {
			if strings.TrimRight(lines[i], " \t") == strings.Repeat(" ", indent)+part+":" {
				found = i
				break
			}
		}
		if found < 0 {
			if depth == 0 {
				t.Fatalf("config has no section %s", section)
			}
			// 生成配置会省略取默认值的子段，显式写入本次测量的覆盖值。
			lines = slices.Insert(lines, end, strings.Repeat(" ", indent)+part+":")
			found = end
			end++
		}
		begin = found + 1
		for i := begin; i < end; i++ {
			trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(lines[i])
			if trimmed != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "#") && len(lines[i])-len(strings.TrimLeft(lines[i], " ")) <= indent {
				end = i
				break
			}
		}
		indent += 2
	}
	prefix := strings.Repeat(" ", indent) + key + ":"
	for i := begin; i < end; i++ {
		if strings.HasPrefix(lines[i], prefix) {
			lines[i] = prefix + " " + value
			return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
		}
	}
	lines = slices.Insert(lines, end, prefix+" "+value)
	return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
}

// procOptions 是进程配置的差异：Redis 地址（经 toxiproxy 时用代理地址）与额外的键。
type procOptions struct {
	redis string
	keys  [][3]string // section, key, value
}

// derive 从生成的开发配置派生一个进程的配置：依赖地址、唯一前缀、本进程的端口与 WAL 目录。
func (s *suite) derive(name, service string, sid int32, index int, opts procOptions) (configPath, ops, client string) {
	t := s.t
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(s.root, "configs", "service", "config."+service+".yaml"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var lines []string
	for _, line := range strings.Split(string(raw), "\n") {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(line), "#") {
			line = projectName.ReplaceAllString(line, s.prefix+"$1")
			line = strings.ReplaceAll(line, "PLANET_", strings.ToUpper(s.prefix)+"_")
		}
		lines = append(lines, line)
	}
	text := strings.Join(lines, "\n")
	redis := s.redisAddr
	if opts.redis != "" {
		redis = opts.redis
	}
	ops = fmt.Sprintf("127.0.0.1:%d", s.portBase+index)
	client = fmt.Sprintf("127.0.0.1:%d", s.portBase+200+index)
	text = strings.ReplaceAll(text, "mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/?replicaSet=rs0", s.mongoURI)
	text = strings.ReplaceAll(text, "nats://127.0.0.1:4222", s.natsURL)
	text = strings.ReplaceAll(text, "127.0.0.1:6379", redis)
	text = strings.ReplaceAll(text, "[127.0.0.1:2379]", "["+s.etcd+"]")
	text = strings.ReplaceAll(text, "0.0.0.0:7000", client)
	// account 进程的登录入口（web.addr，开发配置 8081）也挪到本用例的端口段，免得与本机别的 demo 抢。
	text = strings.ReplaceAll(text, "addr: 127.0.0.1:8081", "addr: "+s.portalAddr())
	text = opsAddr.ReplaceAllString(text, "${1}"+ops)
	text = advertiseAddr.ReplaceAllString(text, fmt.Sprintf("${1}127.0.0.1:%d", s.portBase+100+index))
	// 生成配置缺省是 roost:<工程名>（上面已换成 roost:<前缀>）；本用例按裸前缀读路由键，所以整行换掉。只有带
	// remote_entity 的服务（game、alliance）有这个键；带了却找不到才是生成配置变了。
	if strings.Contains(text, "\nremote_entity:") {
		if !l2Prefix.MatchString(text) {
			t.Fatalf("%s: remote_entity.snapshot_l2_key_prefix not found in the generated config", service)
		}
		text = l2Prefix.ReplaceAllString(text, `${1}"`+s.prefix+`"`)
	}
	text = strings.ReplaceAll(text, "max_bytes: 8589934592", "max_bytes: 268435456")
	text = setKey(t, text, "log", "file", "false")
	text = setKey(t, text, "stats_log", "enabled", "false")
	for _, kv := range opts.keys {
		text = setKey(t, text, kv[0], kv[1], kv[2])
	}
	configPath = filepath.Join(s.work, name+".yaml")
	if err := os.WriteFile(configPath, []byte(text), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return configPath, ops, client
}

// portalAddr 是 account 进程登录入口的地址（端口段末尾，进程端口用不到那里）。
func (s *suite) portalAddr() string { return fmt.Sprintf("127.0.0.1:%d", s.portBase+299) }

// start 起一个服务进程并等它 /readyz 就绪。name 唯一；同名进程停过之后再 start 沿用原配置与端口（同 sid 拉起）。
func (s *suite) start(name, service string, sid int32, opts procOptions) *proc {
	// derive 失败时 t.Fatalf：不能在持锁时调它（停机清理 stopAll 要同一把锁，持锁 Fatal 会让用例挂到超时）。
	s.mu.Lock()
	p := s.procs[name]
	index := s.next
	if p == nil {
		s.next++
	}
	s.mu.Unlock()
	if p == nil {
		config, ops, client := s.derive(name, service, sid, index, opts)
		p = &proc{name: name, service: service, sid: sid, config: config, ops: ops, client: client, log: filepath.Join(s.logs, name+".log")}
		s.mu.Lock()
		s.procs[name] = p
		s.mu.Unlock()
	}
	s.launch(p)
	s.waitReady(p, 120*time.Second)
	return p
}

func (s *suite) launch(p *proc) {
	t := s.t
	if p.cmd != nil {
		select {
		case <-p.done:
		default:
			t.Fatalf("%s is still running", p.name)
		}
	}
	f, err := os.OpenFile(p.log, os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND, 0o644)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cmd := exec.Command(s.binary, p.service, "--sid", fmt.Sprint(p.sid), "--config", p.config)
	cmd.Dir = s.work
	cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = f, f
	if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	p.cmd, p.done = cmd, make(chan struct{})
	go func(p *proc, cmd *exec.Cmd, f *os.File) {
		p.exitErr = cmd.Wait()
		_ = f.Close()
		close(p.done)
	}(p, cmd, f)
	t.Logf("started %s (%s --sid %d) pid %d", p.name, p.service, p.sid, cmd.Process.Pid)
}

func (s *suite) waitReady(p *proc, limit time.Duration) {
	t := s.t
	deadline := time.Now().Add(limit)
	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		select {
		case <-p.done:
			t.Fatalf("%s exited before it was ready (%v); log %s:\n%s", p.name, p.exitErr, p.log, tail(p.log, 20))
		default:
		}
		resp, err := http.Get("http://" + p.ops + "/readyz")
		if err == nil {
			_ = resp.Body.Close()
			if resp.StatusCode == http.StatusOK {
				return
			}
		}
		time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	t.Fatalf("%s not ready within %v; log %s:\n%s", p.name, limit, p.log, tail(p.log, 20))
}

func tail(path string, n int) string {
	raw, _ := os.ReadFile(path)
	lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(string(raw), "\n"), "\n")
	if len(lines) > n {
		lines = lines[len(lines)-n:]
	}
	return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
}

// stop 发信号并等进程退出：SIGINT 走正常停机，SIGKILL 就是 kill -9。
func (s *suite) stop(p *proc, sig syscall.Signal) {
	if p == nil || p.cmd == nil {
		return
	}
	select {
	case <-p.done:
		return
	default:
	}
	if sig == syscall.SIGINT {
		_ = p.cmd.Process.Signal(syscall.SIGCONT)
	}
	_ = p.cmd.Process.Signal(sig)
	select {
	case <-p.done:
	case <-time.After(150 * time.Second):
		_ = p.cmd.Process.Kill()
		<-p.done
	}
	s.t.Logf("stopped %s with %v (%v)", p.name, sig, p.exitErr)
}

func (s *suite) signal(p *proc, sig syscall.Signal) {
	if err := p.cmd.Process.Signal(sig); err != nil {
		s.t.Fatalf("signal %v to %s: %v", sig, p.name, err)
	}
}

func (s *suite) alive(p *proc) bool {
	select {
	case <-p.done:
		return false
	default:
		return true
	}
}

func (s *suite) stopAll() {
	s.mu.Lock()
	var procs []*proc
	for _, p := range s.procs {
		procs = append(procs, p)
	}
	s.mu.Unlock()
	// game 先停，alliance 次之，其余最后（与 deploy/dev/run.sh 的逆序一致）。
	rank := map[string]int{"game": 0, "alliance": 1}
	sort.Slice(procs, func(i, j int) bool {
		ri, ok := rank[procs[i].service]
		if !ok {
			ri = 2
		}
		rj, ok := rank[procs[j].service]
		if !ok {
			rj = 2
		}
		return ri < rj
	})
	for _, p := range procs {
		s.stop(p, syscall.SIGINT)
	}
	errorLines := 0
	for _, p := range procs {
		raw, _ := os.ReadFile(p.log)
		errorLines += bytes.Count(raw, []byte(`"level":"ERROR"`))
	}
	s.t.Logf("all processes stopped; %d ERROR log lines in total", errorLines)
}

// cleanup 删掉本前缀的库、流、键（只删自己的）。
func (s *suite) cleanup() {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	if s.stopBus != nil {
		s.stopBus()
	}
	if s.mongo != nil {
		names, _ := s.mongo.ListDatabaseNames(ctx, bson.M{"name": bson.M{"$regex": "^" + s.prefix}})
		for _, name := range names {
			_ = s.mongo.Database(name).Drop(ctx)
		}
		_ = s.mongo.Disconnect(ctx)
	}
	if s.redis != nil {
		var cursor uint64
		for {
			keys, next, err := s.redis.Scan(ctx, cursor, "*"+s.prefix+"*", 1000).Result()
			if err != nil {
				break
			}
			if len(keys) > 0 {
				s.redis.Del(ctx, keys...)
			}
			if cursor = next; cursor == 0 {
				break
			}
		}
		_ = s.redis.Close()
	}
	if nc, err := nats.Connect(s.natsURL); err == nil {
		if js, err := jetstream.New(nc); err == nil {
			upper := strings.ToUpper(s.prefix)
			names := js.StreamNames(ctx)
			var drop []string
			for name := range names.Name() {
				if strings.Contains(strings.ToUpper(name), upper) {
					drop = append(drop, name)
				}
			}
			for _, name := range drop {
				_ = js.DeleteStream(ctx, name)
			}
		}
		nc.Close()
	}
}

// ---- 运维、Redis、指标 ----

// admin 在进程的 ops 端点上执行一条 /admin 命令，返回 data。
func (s *suite) admin(p *proc, name string, payload any) map[string]any {
	t := s.t
	body := map[string]any{"name": name}
	if payload != nil {
		body["payload"] = payload
	}
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(body)
	req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(s.ctx, http.MethodPost, "http://"+p.ops+"/admin/execute", bytes.NewReader(raw))
	req.Header.Set("X-Admin-Token", "dev-gm-token")
	resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("admin %s on %s: %v", name, p.name, err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	out, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("admin %s on %s: %d %s", name, p.name, resp.StatusCode, out)
	}
	var decoded struct {
		Data map[string]any `json:"data"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(out, &decoded); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("admin %s: %v: %s", name, err, out)
	}
	return decoded.Data
}

func (s *suite) routeValue(id int64) string {
	value, _ := s.redis.Get(s.ctx, coreremote.RouteKey(s.prefix, id)).Result()
	return value
}

// metric 读进程 /metrics 里名字含 name、标签含 labels 的样本之和。
func (s *suite) metric(p *proc, name string, labels ...string) float64 {
	resp, err := http.Get("http://" + p.ops + "/metrics")
	if err != nil {
		s.t.Fatalf("metrics of %s: %v", p.name, err)
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	var sum float64
	scanner := bufio.NewScanner(resp.Body)
	scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 1<<20), 1<<20)
	for scanner.Scan() {
		line := scanner.Text()
		metricName := line
		if cut := strings.IndexAny(line, "{ "); cut >= 0 {
			metricName = line[:cut]
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") || !strings.HasSuffix(metricName, name) {
			continue
		}
		match := true
		for _, label := range labels {
			if !strings.Contains(line, label) {
				match = false
			}
		}
		if !match {
			continue
		}
		fields := strings.Fields(line)
		value, _ := strconv.ParseFloat(fields[len(fields)-1], 64)
		sum += value
	}
	return sum
}

// rssMB 是进程常驻内存（ps 的 rss，MiB）。
func rssMB(p *proc) float64 {
	out, err := exec.Command("ps", "-o", "rss=", "-p", fmt.Sprint(p.cmd.Process.Pid)).Output()
	if err != nil {
		return 0
	}
	kb, _ := strconv.ParseFloat(strings.TrimSpace(string(out)), 64)
	return kb / 1024
}

// toxiproxyRedis 打开 / 关闭 toxiproxy 的 redis 代理（只影响经代理连 Redis 的进程，Redis 本身不动）。
func (s *suite) toxiproxyRedis(enabled bool) {
	t := s.t
	if s.toxiproxy == "" {
		t.Fatal("ROOST_DATAENGINE_IT_TOXIPROXY_URL not set")
	}
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"enabled": enabled})
	resp, err := http.Post(s.toxiproxy+"/proxies/redis", "application/json", bytes.NewReader(raw))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_ = resp.Body.Close()
	if resp.StatusCode/100 != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("toxiproxy redis enabled=%v: %d", enabled, resp.StatusCode)
	}
}

// ---- 断言辅助 ----

func (s *suite) eventually(what string, limit time.Duration, check func() (bool, string)) {
	s.t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(limit)
	last := ""
	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		ok, detail := check()
		if ok {
			return
		}
		last = detail
		time.Sleep(200 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	s.t.Fatalf("%s: not within %v: %s", what, limit, last)
}

// definite 用同一个 RequestID 重发写请求，直到得到确定的答复（成功或业务拒绝）；“可重试 / 结果未知”都重发。
func definite(ctx context.Context, limit time.Duration, call func(context.Context) error) (err error, attempts int) {
	deadline := time.Now().Add(limit)
	for {
		attempts++
		callCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 3*time.Second)
		err = call(callCtx)
		cancel()
		switch servicerpc.Classify(err) {
		case servicerpc.OutcomeOK, servicerpc.OutcomeRejected:
			return err, attempts
		}
		if time.Now().After(deadline) {
			return err, attempts
		}
		time.Sleep(200 * time.Millisecond)
	}
}

// found 建一个开放加入的联盟（Found 走队列组，落到哪个实例由总线决定）。
func (s *suite) found(client *rpcalliance.BusClient, leader int64) rpcalliance.Reply {
	s.t.Helper()
	var reply rpcalliance.Reply
	err, _ := definite(s.ctx, time.Minute, func(ctx context.Context) error {
		var err error
		reply, err = client.Found(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("found-%d", leader), leader, 1000, fmt.Sprintf("e2e-%d", leader), true)
		return err
	})
	if err != nil {
		s.t.Fatalf("found by %d: %v", leader, err)
	}
	return reply
}

// foundOn 建联盟直到 sid 上有 n 个，返回这些联盟 ID（其余实例上建的也留着，不影响用例）。
func (s *suite) foundOn(client *rpcalliance.BusClient, sid int32, n int, nextLeader *int64) []int64 {
	var ids []int64
	for tries := 0; len(ids) < n; tries++ {
		if tries > 50*n+50 {
			s.t.Fatalf("Found never landed %d times on %d", n, sid)
		}
		*nextLeader++
		reply := s.found(client, *nextLeader)
		if reply.ServedBySID == sid {
			ids = append(ids, reply.Alliance.AllianceID)
		}
	}
	return ids
}

func target(t *testing.T, allianceID int64) int64 {
	id, err := rpcalliance.AllianceTarget(allianceID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return id
}

func guard(t *testing.T, playerID int64) int64 {
	id, err := rpcalliance.GuardTarget(playerID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return id
}

// members 是联盟答复里的成员 ID。
func members(view alliancerule.View) map[int64]bool {
	out := make(map[int64]bool, len(view.Members))
	for _, member := range view.Members {
		out[member.PlayerID] = true
	}
	return out
}

// percentile 取已排序样本的 p 分位。
func percentile(sorted []time.Duration, p float64) time.Duration {
	if len(sorted) == 0 {
		return 0
	}
	index := int(float64(len(sorted)-1) * p)
	return sorted[index]
}
